findings.note: MigrateLegacyRuns moves each run with os.Rename. If the git common dir is on a different filesystem from the main checkout (e.g. --separate-git-dir / GIT_DIR on another volume), Rename fails with EXDEV and, since roots() runs the migration on every fsm command, every fsm command fails with ERR_STORE_PATH until the user moves the runs by hand. Uncommon layout; a copy+remove fallback on EXDEV (or a clearer error) would cover it.

The legacy-ledger skip stamp keys on file size only: a legacy runs.jsonl rewritten to the same byte length (e.g. hand-edited or rotated) would be skipped. Harmless in normal append-only use; noted as a nit.
